column2: By the mercy of Gopaal, somehow these days passed in Hyderabad and Sri Vrindavan Dhaam.
To participate in the festival at Vrindavan, the journey began on April fifteenth, nineteen seventy five.
On April seventeenth, nineteen seventy five, this servant arrived in Vrindavan.

April twentieth, nineteen seventy five was Rama Navami Day, on this auspicious day, the deity installation festival was performed (at Shri Krishna Balaram temple established by Shrila Guru Maharaj in Vrindavan, Ramana Reti).
This festival continued for one week.
Following the divine order of Shri Guru, this servant travelled to Vrindavan, especially to receive sannyasa deeksha.
On April twenty third, nineteen seventy five, Wednesday, this servant accepted the danda (tridanda).
From today this servant offers his body, mind, speech, along with the self to the Lord (Shri Krishna).
May Prabhu (Lord Shri Krishna) shower His transcendental knowledge, devotion and divine potency on this servant.
May this servant pass his life in Your divine service, pure love and transcendental bliss.
Oh my Lord, Gopaal... please shower Your mercy.
May this servant achieve Krishna prema along with proper devotee association, well-wishers and companions.
May this servant achieve success in the service of Shri Shri Guru and Gauranga.
